description: Clean up experimental workspace by consolidating to production-ready code. Your workspace at /home/ga/workspace/api_middleware/ contains three rate limiter implementations (rate_limiter_v1.py, rate_limiter_v2.py, rate_limiter_v3.py) plus temporary files (test_rate_limiter_temp.py, debug_utils.py, benchmark_results.txt). The Redis-based v3 was chosen for production. TASKS: (1) Rename rate_limiter_v3.py to rate_limiter.py, (2) Delete ALL experimental files: rate_limiter_v1.py, rate_limiter_v2.py, rate_limiter_v3.py (original), test_rate_limiter_temp.py, debug_utils.py, benchmark_results.txt, (3) In rate_limiter.py, remove ALL debug print() statements (especially those containing 'DEBUG'), remove ALL TODO and FIXME comments, remove large blocks of commented-out code, (4) Add module-level docstring at top explaining 'Redis-based distributed rate limiter using sliding window algorithm', (5) Add class docstring to RedisRateLimiter class, (6) Add method docstrings to __init__ and is_allowed methods, (7) Update requirements.txt to include 'redis>=4.5.0' (add it as a new line), (8) Stage all changes via Git Source Control panel (Ctrl+Shift+G) and create commit with message 'Add Redis-based rate limiter'. Final state should have ONLY rate_limiter.py and requirements.txt in workspace, with a new git commit.
